I will use a PUG-REST query to search for Food Additive-related entries and then filter properties. Here is a minimal Python snippet to attempt a text search and filter for the constraints:

import requests
base = "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/food%20additive/JSON"
r = requests.get(base)
d = r.json()
results = []
for c in d.get('PC_Compounds', []):
    props = {}
    for p in c.get('props', []):
        if 'urn' in p and 'label' in p['urn'] and 'value' in p:
            label = p['urn']['label']
            props[label] = p['value']
    mw = props.get('Molecular Weight', {}).get('fval')
    heavy = props.get('Heavy Atom Count', {}).get('ival')
    hba = props.get('HB Acceptor Count', {}).get('ival')
    complexity = props.get('Complexity', {}).get('ival')
    cid = c.get('id', {}).get('id', {}).get('cid')
    if mw and heavy and hba is not None and complexity:
        if mw <= 100 and heavy == 6 and hba <= 1 and 10 <= complexity <= 15:
            results.append({'cid': cid, 'mw': mw, 'heavy': heavy, 'hba': hba, 'complexity': complexity})
print(results)

Please run and share the output.
